object: WE0913A = 2014-065B = Long March 3C third stage from Chang'e 5-T1 (launched 2014-10-23 18:00 UTC); first misidentified as 2015-007B, the DSCOVR Falcon 9 second stage

find_orb_elements_jan_arc.source: https://projectpluto.com/temp/dscovr.htm (Find_Orb, 111 observations 2022 Jan 15-20, mean residual 0.731 arcsec)

jpl_prediction_note: Per https://projectpluto.com/temp/imaged.htm the crater was ~8 km from JPL's predicted point and ~16 km from Gray's; uncertainty ~ a dozen km because the last observations were ~4 weeks before impact.

crater.source: LROC, M. Robinson, 2022-06-23, https://lroc.im-ldi.com/posts/1261 (before M1400727806L 2022-02-28, after M1407760984R 2022-05-21)
crater.description: double crater, eastern 18 m on western 16 m, ~28-29 m across, NE rim of Hertzsprung basin
